title: Ocimum basilicum essential oil for medicinal use
intro: Ocimum basilicum essential oil is a concentrated extract derived from the leaves of the basil plant, known for its aromatic and therapeutic properties. It is commonly used in herbalism for its calming, antiseptic, and digestive benefits. This essential oil can be applied topically to relieve muscle pain or used in aromatherapy to reduce stress and anxiety. It is also valued for its ability to support respiratory health and promote mental clarity. In traditional medicine, it has been utilized to treat headaches, nausea, and skin infections.
